'''Kazak''' was a nature [[Deity/Legends|spirit]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that gave [[Magic/Legends|magical]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] to those who could beat him at his complex games. The legendary warrior [[Tokat]] won a magic bow from him. "Kazak" was a popular name for male [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]].<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kazak was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
